---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: 'Feat: '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe. / 该功能需求是否与现有问题相关？请描述**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]
简洁清晰地描述当前存在的痛点问题。例如：我在使用过程中经常遇到 [...] 的问题，影响使用体验。

**Describe the solution you'd like / 描述你期望的解决方案**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.
简洁清晰地描述你希望实现的功能、优化方案与效果。

**Which package forms does this affect? / 影响哪些打包形态**
[e.g. all / Web only / EXE unified only / APK thin only]
【例：全部 / 仅 Web / 仅 EXE unified / 仅 APK thin】

**How does it fit the existing architecture? / 如何融入现有架构**
Explain how it lands in the current layering (`controller → service → repository → model`), the context layers (L0 persona / L1 skill index / L2 triggered skills / compacted history), or the packaging matrix.
说明它落在现有分层的哪一层（`controller → service → repository → model`）、上下文的哪一层（L0 人设 / L1 能力索引 / L2 触发技能 / 压缩后 HISTORY），或打包矩阵的哪一环。

Persona and skill behaviour must come from skill Markdown and configuration, not hard-coded branches — see [docs/SKILL-PROTOCOL.md](https://github.com/Romi-Brooks/Cuetiy/blob/main/docs/SKILL-PROTOCOL.md) and [docs/issue/CONTEXT-SKILL-DESIGN.md](https://github.com/Romi-Brooks/Cuetiy/blob/main/docs/issue/CONTEXT-SKILL-DESIGN.md).
人设与技能行为必须来自技能 Markdown 与配置，不得写死在业务代码分支里 —— 见 [docs/SKILL-PROTOCOL.md](https://github.com/Romi-Brooks/Cuetiy/blob/main/docs/SKILL-PROTOCOL.md) 与 [docs/issue/CONTEXT-SKILL-DESIGN.md](https://github.com/Romi-Brooks/Cuetiy/blob/main/docs/issue/CONTEXT-SKILL-DESIGN.md)。

**Describe alternatives you've considered / 描述你考虑过的替代方案**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.
简洁清晰地说明你曾考虑过的其他解决方案或替代功能思路。

**Additional context / 补充说明**
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here. If this needs design work first, it can live in [docs/issue/](https://github.com/Romi-Brooks/Cuetiy/tree/main/docs/issue) before implementation.
在此填写该功能需求的其他相关信息、使用场景或相关截图。如果它需要先做方案评估，可以先落到 [docs/issue/](https://github.com/Romi-Brooks/Cuetiy/tree/main/docs/issue)。
